svg.title: Semantic search in the Helpdesk pipeline (state 0.97.226, 2026-11-15)

g.text: Semantic search in the Helpdesk pipeline (state 0.97.226, 2026-11-15)
A. Preparing the sources (when a source changes; nightly on prod)
Prepare the text of a piece
heading, short summary of element names
+ pieces with rare words of the question
reads the question and the 6 passages,
per piece: text, vector, word index,
Example files are cut by size, in the middle of
elements, with no trace of where a piece sits.
The pieces of one file then look alike to the
search, and the file's opening wins too often.
Planned: cut at element boundaries, each piece
starts with its path in the document.
The right file can be found and the wrong
piece of it passed on: the model then says
the cited file holds the answer.
not about the sources: refusal, no search
decides what the vectors can tell apart
The same embedding model is used on both sides: a piece and a question
that mean the same get vectors that lie close together.
